scenario: Discussing weekend plans with a friend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isethwa kangcono ukukhuluma ngamacwangco noma izibopho.
Isethwa no- 'to' ukubeka indawo noma inkinga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Ingabe unomphathiswa ngesihambisana?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Ngicabanga ukuthi ngitha ngihambe eduze, kodwa mhlawumbe izakuba nenani kangangoko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Isicabiso esihle! Kodwa, ingabe unesikhathi sokuhamba nami?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I have time because I finished my work early.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, nginesikhathi ngoba ngqedile umsebenzi wami ngokushesha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.
dialogue.translation: Iphephethe! Ngicabanga ukuthi izakuba isihambisana esihle.

scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Sawubona, ngithenge leli kholwa lapha, kodwa alisebenzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyaxolisa ngalokho. Uthe thishiye ngubani lapho uthenge?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Kuphela izinsuku ezimbili edlule. Ngifuna othisha, uma kunjalo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Yebo. Thatha le fomula uyifule. Emva kwakho, nginike isikhululo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga. Ngakho-ke ngikunike i kholwa elibi emuva, ngithole othisha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Ngokwanele. Uma ude banzi ubizo, ngicela ngicela.

scenario: Booking a table at a restaurant by phone
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ekontekiswini yendawo yokudla, isetshenziswa ukudlulisela itheyibhu eliyazakhiwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to book a table for tonight.
dialogue.translation: Sawubona, ndidinga ukwakha itheyibhu ngobusuku obusenjengalokhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. For how many people?
dialogue.translation: Yebo. Ngabantu abangakashanu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For four people, please.
dialogue.translation: Ngabantu abane, nje.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have a free table at 8 o'clock. Is that okay?
dialogue.translation: Sinethayibhu eliyasekho ngamaxesha amane. Kuyajabula na?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll call back to confirm later.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kulungile. Ndokubuyisela ukukhomba emuva.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Kuhle. Ngingaithola igama lakho ekhokweni?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngaphansi kwegama lika García.

scenario: Describing symptoms at a pharmacy
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kusetshenziswa ukuze kuboniswe ukuthi uyadlala kanjani ngokomzimba noma ngokomoya.
Ukucaphisa amagama okusebenza njengemisebenzi noma amagama okusebenza njengemisebenzi.
Kusetshenziswa nezinhlobo ezingenakubalwa noma ukuze kubeke izincazelo zemisebenzi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I feel very bad since yesterday.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyadlala kakhulu kusukela ngenyanga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What do you have?
dialogue.translation: Unani?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My head hurts, and I still have a lot of pain.
dialogue.translation: Intwe yami iyabhubha, ngisengisho nezihlukanehlo ezinengi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any other symptoms?
dialogue.translation: Unezimpawu ezinye?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I also feel tired most of the day.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, nabo ngiyadlala ukuthukutheka ngosuku lonke.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take this medicine while you are here, and you will feel better soon.
dialogue.translation: Thatha le muthi nxa uyapha lapha, uyoba wedlala kahle ngokushesha.

scenario: Talking about your hometown to a visitor
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isihlela esingaphansi komthetho: live - lived - lived.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: Welizwe emzini wami! Yindawo encane, kodwa ngiyithanda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga! Uphi lapha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.
dialogue.translation: Ngiphila phesheya kwesikole samadla. Imnandi kakhulu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oh, mnandi! Kune imarket ngosuku lonke?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngihamba khona ngosuku lonke ukuthenga izinto ezisha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Kuyabona mnandi. Ngaleso sikhathi singahamba ngisho?

scenario: Changing a reservation at a hotel
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Sawubona, ngiyadinga ukubuyisela isibonelo sami ngosuku olunye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?
dialogue.translation: Yebo. Uyathanda ukufika ngenkathi okanye emva?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Emva, nje. Ingabe igumbi lidonselwe ngeviki elizayo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. We have another room free after Monday.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyekele ukubuka. Sinenye indlu eyasemanje emva kweMsombuluko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I change my reservation to that day?
dialogue.translation: Okuhle. Ngingabuyisela yini isibonelo sami ngalolo suku?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but you must confirm before Friday.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kodwa kumele uqinisekise ngaphambi kweNgcinane.

scenario: Asking for advice on what to buy
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to buy something for my brother, but I don't have much money.
dialogue.translation: Ngifisa ukuthenga into enye kumfowethu wami, kodwa anginawo imali eningi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What's the price range? Something cheap or expensive?
dialogue.translation: Yini isikhala sobuningi? Into enye encane okanye enkulu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheap, please. Can you recommend a good gift for a buyer like me?
dialogue.translation: Encane, nje. Ungancomeka iphuzu elihle kumthengi ojinjengami?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I advise you to choose a nice mug or a book.
dialogue.translation: Yebo. Ngikunikeza ukuthi ukhethe icwaningu elihle okanye incwadi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great! I'll take your advice and choose the mug.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle! Ngizokuthatha usizo lwakho ngikhethe icwaningu.

scenario: Talking about past holidays
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you go anywhere last year?
dialogue.translation: Ingabe uhambile nlapho eduze unyaka odlule?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I went to the beach. The weather was really good there.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngihambile ebeach. Imo yezi kwakumnandi kakhulu khona.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Did you get time to relax?
dialogue.translation: Lokhu kuvele kuhle. Ingabe usithole isikhathi sokuphumula?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, because it was very quiet. I loved it.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngoba kwakuyothula kakhulu. Ngiyathanda lokho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Did you come back tired?
dialogue.translation: Kuhle. Ingabe ufike ubuyela unethuli?

scenario: Discussing what you did last weekend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Seyenzelwa nge-object direct: zondlulisela umndeni wam.

vocabulary.translation: phandle, phuma (emazwini anjengokuthi 'eat out' = yidla phandle)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! What did you do this weekend?
dialogue.translation: Molo! Wenza ntoni ngesikhathi saseweekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I visited my grandparents and stayed at their house.
dialogue.translation: Ngezondlulisela ouphawu bami nehlala endlini yabo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you enjoy it?
dialogue.translation: Kuhle! Wathokoza yini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we watched a movie together on Saturday.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, sabuka ifilimu kanye ngoMsombuluko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds great. Did you go out to eat?
dialogue.translation: Kuyabona mnandi. Naphuma ukudla yini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, because we cooked at home. It was very relaxing.
dialogue.translation: Hayi, ngoba sasibiza ekhaya. Kwakuyinyamaza kakhulu.

key_phrases.phrase: What did you do this weekend?

scenario: Planning a birthday party
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to plan the party for Ana's birthday. How many people should we invite?
dialogue.translation: Sidinga ukwenza uhlahlo lomphando kaAna. Abantu abangaki abasedinga ukubiza?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I have an idea: let's invite about ten friends. When is the party going to be?
dialogue.translation: Nithalente: masibize abangane abangashumi. Lapho usuka khona umphando?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: On Saturday afternoon. We also need a big cake for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Ngosuku lwesikhombisa ngosuku. Sidinga nangikheki elikhulu abantu bonke.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good. I can make the cake, and we can play a fun game outside.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle. Ngingakwenza ikheki, futhi singadlala umdlalo ojabulisayo phandle.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. Now we only need to buy the decorations.
dialogue.translation: Okho kuvele kuhle. Manje sidinga kupha ukuthenga izinto zokuhlela.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, we have a plan! When you go, remember to get some balloons too.
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, sinohlahlo! Lapho uhamba khona, khumbula ukuthatha amabaloni.

scenario: Asking about public transport routes
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how can I take a bus to the museum?
dialogue.translation: Uxolo, ngingathatha njani ibhesi yaya emyuezimini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take the number 5 bus from the stop here, and then get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Thatha ibhesi elinombolo 5 kusuka endaweni yokuma lapha, ngansuka hla phansi endaweniyokuma elandelayo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it far from here?
dialogue.translation: Kude na kusuka lapha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's not far. After you get off, walk left for two minutes, and the museum is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Hayi, akukude. Emva kokuhla phansi, hamba ngenkululeko imizuzu emibili, umyuezimu uyakuba ekunene kwakho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, so I take the bus and then walk a little. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Kuhle, ngakho-ke ngithatha ibhesi ngansuka ngihambe ngokuncane. Ngiyabonga!

scenario: Talking about your job to someone new
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngesekelwa sakho nomsebenzi wakho.
Isikhathi esisodwa; ngokuvamile sitshenziswa ngokuthi isikhathi eside.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Mark. What do you do?
dialogue.translation: Sawubona! NginguMark. Uyasebenza njani?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I work at a small company. My job is interesting, but sometimes it's hard.
dialogue.translation: Ngisebenza enkampani encane. Umsebenzi wami uyavuza, kodwa ngemarube ayinzima.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. What are your hours?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona. Iziphumo zakho ziyini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I start at nine and finish at five. I often work late on Fridays.
dialogue.translation: Ngisaqala ngakhamba kuye ngamashumi amahlanu nangagqatsa ngamashumi amahlanu. Ngisebenza ngokuvamile ngosuku lwesihlanu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's not too bad. Tell me more about your company.
dialogue.translation: Alukho lutho olubi. Ngikhulume ngokuhambisana nenkampani yakho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. We make software for schools. It's a good place to work.
dialogue.translation: Yebo. Siyenzela izikhulelo zezikhulelo zezikhulelo. Yindawo enhle yokusebenza.

key_phrases.phrase: I start at nine and finish at five.
key_phrases.translation: Ngisaqala ngakhamba kuye ngamashumi amahlanu nangagqatsa ngamashumi amahlanu.

scenario: Describing your home and neighborhood
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Umbungazi omanezi amagama noma amafleti amanengi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Where do you live?
dialogue.translation: Uhlala phi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live in a small building on the fifth floor. It's very quiet here.
dialogue.translation: Ngihlala endlini encane esigcawini esihlanu. Iphukile kakhulu lapha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Is there a park near your street?
dialogue.translation: Kubonakala kuhle. Kune iphepha ephedeni kwesitali sakho?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a big park just two blocks away. But it's always crowded on weekends.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kune iphepha elikhulu eduze nje amabloku amabili. Kodwa linetshaba ngesikhathi sesihla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My apartment is small too, but it's near a quiet street.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona. Ifleti yami nencane, kodwa iphedeni kwesitali esiphukile.

scenario: Making plans for the next day
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kuyavunywa kakhulu, kodwa awakho ekhulumnini lwezinto ezikhethiweyo.
Nangona ikhona ekhulumnini lwezinto ezikhethiweyo, kudingeka ukuba kukhona ukuze kube khona ukukhuluma ngokwenhlala; seyabelwa ediyalogini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Ufuna ukwenza ntoni kusukela ekuseni?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Angazi. Mhlawumbe singahlangana endaweni esijwayelekileyo ngaphambi kwehora eli-9?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: Liyinkathi yami, kodwa ngingakukhomba emva kwexesha ukuze ngiqinisekise.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile, kodwa ungakhombisi ngenkathi kakhulu ngoba ngiyahla ngenkathi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Ngiqinisile, ngizokukhomba ngaphambi kwehora eli-8. Ngakho-ke singahola usuku olungileyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Iphephethe. Ngiqinisile ukuthi kuzoba usuku olumnandi.

scenario: Complaining politely about a problem
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isikhathi esetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngokudingeka noma ukungahleli.
Isikhathi esetshenziswa ukuxolisa noma ukubonisa ukudeda.
Ecaleni lokusebenza kwazo izinto, ithi vula noma buyisa.
Izenzo ebalulekile yokubonisa ukuqonda noma ukungabi naqo.
Izenzo ebalulekile; lapha ithi vula noma buyisa.
Isikhathi esetshenziswa ukukhulisa umthetho noma ukudeda.
Isikhathi esetshenziswa ezikhombisweni noma imibuzweni ukubonisa ukuthi into ayikwenzekanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Uxolo, nginengxaki engezweni yami. ITV ayivuli.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyaxolisa ukuzwa lokho. Ingadonsi yonke na?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ngizame, kodwa ayisebenzanga. Ngingaqondi ukuthi kungani.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Mhlawumbe kukhona ukuxhumana okubi. Ngiyekeme ukuhlola. Ngezisa izenza isebenze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabonga. Angiboni lutho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ngakhohlwa ukuthi ungayifaka ngoku.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Ngokwesibonelo. Ngiyaxolisa ngokungahleli. Ngezisa ngiyekeme ukuhlola.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Ngabuka ifilimu entsha kusalku. Yabe imnandi kakhulu!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Oho ngempela? Yindaba mayelana nani?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Iyaphakeme ngendoda eyayilahla ngesikhathi. Kodwa isiphetho singezansi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Kuyabona enomthelela. Ngifunda nje incwadi, angifilimi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Ifilimu lihle kunincwadi, ngicabanga. Kodwa ngaleso sikhathi angifundanga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Emva kokugcina amaxabiso ami, ngizobuka. Ngiyabonga ngenhlakanipho!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Sawubona. Ninesibpho esihle kuwe. Kuqala, ungathanda kanjani lo msebenzi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyakuthanda kakhulu ukusebenza nabantu, nginokubeka kwisebenzisa abantu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona. Nangabe, ungasebenza ngesikhathi esivela?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, kufanele. Ngingasebenza ngeSathithi nangeSonto.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Kuhle. Nini ungasela?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Ngingasela iviki elizayo ngoba kudingeka ngiphendule kwisebenzi sami esimanje.

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isethwa ukuze khulise amavumelwano noma izincazelo

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Uthanda ukudla ukuthini ukudla kwesikhathi sokuza?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ngiyithanda ipasta, kodwa angifisi lutho olukhulayo namuhla usuku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Sinokuthile inkukhu namathunu kwesifubeki. Lokho kungaba khona.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Lokho kuvele khona. Kodwa ngifisa ngempela into enomkhusano omude.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Ukuze sikhethe iphepha lokudla noma isinkwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, lokho kuyinto enhle. Ngakho-ke singadla kunye, nami ngasikwenza ukudla noma.

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isizo esiqotho sokupheka noma ukubiza usizo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Ungangisiza? Idinga ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha yami, kodwa isikrini siyisikhala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Ewe. Ngiyekele ukubona. Uwudonsile ibhatshi elihle?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Ewe, ngiyenzile. Kodwa alusebenzanga. Mhlawumbe iwele.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Ake siwise futhi. Ngemarhu ayasebenzisa emva kwesikhathi eside.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Kulungile, ngizohlela. Kodwa, ngoba kunesidingo, idinga manje.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Ngiyabona. Ngiyekele ukuhlola ibhatshi lokushisa. Ah, lapha! Manje isebenza!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Isikhathi eside; isetshenziswa ukukhuluma ngokuthwala ngeinyanga.
Isetshenziswa ukusho ukuthi kufakiwe yini kuxabiso.
Nathisa uthi 'isitali', kodwa lapha yindlela yokubiza indawo yasekhaya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Sawubona, ngifuna ukuthwala idyli. Ingadonsela manje?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Yebo, ingadonsela. Ukuthwala kiyimali eyisi-800 ngeinyanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Ingaba lo mxabiso ufaka amanzi neleketirithi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Hayi, ufaka amanzi kuphela. Ileketirithi iyinkanyezi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Futhi isitali siphakathi kwawo? Kuseduze noma isitolo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Isesitali esithathu, futhi isiphakathi kwesitolo esikhulu esibili. Mhlawumbe ungazothola kusasa.
